name: Airlan
summary: Snowy Mountains / South East NSW licensed wireless broadband carrier + ISP (Jindabyne & Merimbula NOCs; also hosting, IT, cabling); founded c.2004, still registered (trading name of THE TRUSTEE FOR GREGORIAN FAMILY TRUST, ABN 91 441 214 405).

events.details: Founder-run, 100% Australian-owned licensed telecom carrier/ISP on its own wireless network; NOCs at Jindabyne and Merimbula, NSW. Trading name 'Airlan' (ABN 91 441 214 405) registered 13 Jan 2005; site copyright dates from 2003/2004.
Not defunct in the 2000s: the site operated continuously (About Us page live 2011-2025); website content froze c.2019 (copyright '2003-2019'), while the ABN and GST registration remain active.
